name: HALLIBURTON COMPANY

overrides_applied.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-06, accession 0000045012-26-000015), Note 14 Stock-based Compensation table: stock-based compensation cost $213 million for 2025, $223 million for 2024 and $219 million for 2023. EDGAR companyfacts carries ShareBasedCompensation only through 2014, so the engine found no FY SBC for 2023-2025.
overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:sbc - SBC missing for fiscal years 2023, 2024, 2025 of the last 3 under the engine's tags. The filer's own reported FY2025 stock-based compensation cost from its 10-K Note 14 fills the gap; the engine applies this single value to every missing period. The true per-year series in the same table is $219M (FY2023) / $223M (FY2024) / $213M (FY2025), so applying $213M to all three years is within $10M of the true figure in each year and is immaterial to the median base (under $0.02/share in the median year).

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override

NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:sbc — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (filing: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-06, accession 0000045012-26-000015), Note 14 Stock-based Compensation table: stock-based compensation cost $213 million for 2025, $223 million for 2024 and $219 million for 2023. EDGAR companyfacts carries ShareBasedCompensation only through 2014, so the engine found no FY SBC for 2023-2025.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 3.2x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
